purpose: Complete final proposal source map. Carries critic's independent primary-source records with S01-S13 URL bindings preserved; adds reviser direct rechecks for the two disputed DuckDB claims.

sources.title: RFC 4180 — Common Format and MIME Type for CSV Files
sources.locator: §2 items 3–7 and ABNF; §3 security and interoperability notes.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the RFC and checked its status, format caveats, field rules, quoted line breaks, and security notes.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The RFC states there is no single formal CSV specification and describes a common format; quoted fields may contain CR/LF, comma, and doubled quotes. It notes private data can be shared through CSV.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft's use of RFC 4180 as common-format context and its warning that physical lines are not always records.
sources.evidence_limitations: Informational description, not a universal CSV standard or stock-application contract.

sources.title: W3C Metadata Vocabulary for Tabular Data
sources.observed_operation: Opened the dated Recommendation and checked its abstract, status, dialect defaults and column metadata sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The default dialect lists UTF-8, CRLF/LF, quote/doubleQuote, header and comma defaults; metadata can describe schema and columns, with page-defined overrides.
sources.applicability: A vocabulary example for a documented local profile subset, not a requirement to implement CSVW processing.
sources.evidence_limitations: Web tabular-data metadata does not determine supplier identity, stock semantics, transactions or user workflow.

sources.title: Rust csv 1.4.0 ReaderBuilder API
sources.observed_operation: Direct open of the versioned URL returned an internal error; a docs.rs search result for the current API was labeled csv 1.4.0 and exposed the flexible default/error behavior. The tagged 1.4.0 source was checked separately as S05.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: When flexible is disabled (default), unequal record field counts error; enabling it turns off that check.
sources.applicability: A candidate explicit-profile streaming parser if Rust fits the target application; width errors still need product classification.
sources.evidence_limitations: The versioned docs page itself did not render in the direct open; source corroboration is S05 and search-rendered docs are not an application test.

sources.title: Rust csv 1.4.0 Position API
sources.locator: Position overview and byte(), line(), record() methods.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the versioned Position API; cross-checked its API description against docs.rs current results labeled csv 1.4.0.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Position carries byte offset, physical line and record index; byte and record start at 0, line starts at 1; reader assigns record positions.
sources.applicability: Supports using logical-record/byte provenance and treating physical line as a separate display aid.
sources.evidence_limitations: Does not specify the product's displayed locator contract or guarantee other parsers use the same bases.

sources.title: BurntSushi rust-csv reader source and inline tests
sources.release_or_commit: Git ref and crate release 1.4.0; tag commit SHA not separately resolved
sources.locator: ReaderBuilder defaults and flexible docs around lines 169–177, 300–303, 419–460; unequal-length check around 1842–1847; read_record_unequal_ok around 2268–2279.
sources.observed_operation: Opened tagged source and inspected defaults, the width check, error position, escape behavior, and inline test.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: First record is a special header by default; unequal field counts error by default and include record position; flexible(true) bypasses that check. Backslash-style escape recognition is disabled unless configured; double-quote escaping is enabled by default.
sources.applicability: Corroborates the Rust parser comparison, strict width handling, and location discussion.
sources.evidence_limitations: Parser source/test only; no app-level tests or release-history analysis for an unknown application.

sources.title: Python 3.14 csv module documentation
sources.release_or_commit: Python 3.14 documentation page; opened page identified Python 3.14.8
sources.locator: reader/QUOTE_NONNUMERIC; Dialect.strict; Sniffer and preferred; Reader Objects line_num; newline guidance.
sources.observed_operation: Opened current 3.14 docs and searched line_num and Sniffer sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Reader returns strings absent a conversion quoting mode; QUOTE_NONNUMERIC converts unquoted fields to float; strict defaults false; line_num counts physical source lines, and Sniffer infers from a sample with documented tie preferences.
sources.applicability: Supports the standard-library alternative and cautions against treating inference or physical line count as confirmed mapping/provenance.
sources.evidence_limitations: Runtime version and encoding behavior in the target application are unknown.

sources.title: CPython 3.14.8 csv implementation and tests
sources.locator: Sniffer.preferred/sniff in Lib/csv.py; Lib/test/test_csv.py test_read_linenum, test_read_bigfield (50,000-character fields), and test_roundtrip_quoteed_newlines (the test's actual spelling).
sources.observed_operation: Opened tagged implementation and test file; searched for Sniffer tie handling, physical line count, field-size coverage, and quoted-newline round trip.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Sniffer uses the preferred delimiter order on a tie; tests exercise physical-line counts, 50,000-character fields, and quoted newline round trips.
sources.applicability: Versioned implementation/test evidence for Python behavior and useful proposed fixture cases.
sources.evidence_limitations: CPython tests are not tests for the supplier importer and were not executed in this stage.

sources.title: DuckDB CSV Import documentation (preview)
sources.release_or_commit: Moving preview documentation; no immutable release or commit exposed
sources.locator: CSV option table: sample_size; all_varchar; strict_mode; decimal_separator; thousands; store_rejects; auto-detection sections.
sources.observed_operation: Opened current preview documentation and inspected the parameter table and auto-detection text.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: sample_size is explicitly the number of sample lines for auto detection, default 20,480. strict_mode defaults true; all_varchar and store_rejects default false; decimal and thousands separators are configurable and must differ.
sources.applicability: A local query-engine alternative only if a pinned release and full-file validation meet requirements; sample detection is not approval to apply stock changes.
sources.evidence_limitations: Moving preview docs, not pinned to a release. The 20,480 unit is lines, not logical rows; see critique F1.

sources.title: DuckDB issue #25827 — dialect change can discard earlier rows
sources.release_or_commit: Issue opened 17 September 2026; Open / needs-triage when checked; author reports main commit 2bbfe6f236, v2.1.0-dev84749, 1.6.0.dev214, 1.5.5, 1.4.2 and 1.1.3.
sources.locator: Issue description/reproduction, sample_size/null_padding results, version matrix, issue status and activity.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the issue, checked status/labels and independently read the reproductions and reported tested builds; did not run the supplied code or reproduce the issue.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Reporter says a later dialect/width match caused earlier records including a header to be skipped; sample_size=-1 did not fix the reported wide.csv case, while null_padding=true retained 30,000 rows with altered inferred columns. Results are reporter-reported.
sources.applicability: Risk evidence for not trusting sniffer counts without a full-file reconciliation and for pinning/regression-testing any DuckDB release considered.
sources.evidence_limitations: Open issue report, no critic reproduction and no guarantee for all releases; do not state the reported matrix as independently verified.

sources.title: BurntSushi rust-csv Discussion #402 — unequal field counts
sources.locator: Question on unequal header/record widths and accepted maintainer response.
sources.observed_operation: Opened discussion and checked maintainer response.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Maintainer explains header names do not control field-count validation and flexible parsing disables the unequal-length error.
sources.applicability: Additional explanation for S03/S05, not a substitute for the parser API/source.
sources.evidence_limitations: Discussion answer, not a release note or app behavior.

sources.title: SQLite Transactions
sources.release_or_commit: Current SQLite documentation; no immutable release shown
sources.locator: Transaction start modes; BEGIN IMMEDIATE and SQLITE_BUSY.
sources.observed_operation: Opened transaction documentation and checked IMMEDIATE writer behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately and may fail SQLITE_BUSY when another writer is active.
sources.applicability: Conditional only if the actual stock store is SQLite; supports reporting a recoverable busy conflict.
sources.evidence_limitations: Backend, transaction duration and application concurrency are unknown.

sources.title: SQLite UPSERT
sources.release_or_commit: UPSERT introduced in SQLite 3.24.0; generalized in 3.35.0; page updated 2024-04-11
sources.locator: Conflict target/DO UPDATE behavior and §4 History.
sources.observed_operation: Opened documentation and checked conflict handling and history.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: UPSERT chooses an action on a configured uniqueness/primary-key conflict; DO UPDATE may update the conflicting row. The syntax does not define inventory meaning or batch idempotency.
sources.applicability: Conditional support for an import receipt/row ledger if SQLite is used; uniqueness keys need the product's intended scope.
sources.evidence_limitations: Does not decide supplier identity, snapshot/delta semantics, or transaction policy.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 COPY
sources.locator: COPY FROM defaults; ON_ERROR, REJECT_LIMIT, LOG_VERBOSITY and ENCODING options.
sources.observed_operation: Opened PostgreSQL 18 docs and searched ON_ERROR and reject-reporting sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: COPY fails on processing errors by default. ON_ERROR ignore can skip conversion-error rows; without REJECT_LIMIT it can skip unlimited errors. Verbose logging can report input line and column for ignored conversion errors.
sources.applicability: Conditional server-database staging option only if PostgreSQL is the actual backend; requires retained row-level diagnostics for review.
sources.evidence_limitations: Does not define all CSV structural failures or product reconciliation, and the target backend is unknown.

lineage.identity_rule: S01-S13 retain their carried source IDs and URL bindings. The critic records are carried forward; the reviser rechecks supplement S08 and S09 without rebinding IDs.
lineage.correction: The investigator S08 record described sample_size as rows. The critic source map and reviser direct check establish that the current DuckDB documentation defines it as sample lines.

reviser_rechecks.title: DuckDB CSV Import documentation (preview)
reviser_rechecks.release_or_commit: Moving 2.0-dev preview page, as identified in the page header at access; no immutable release or commit exposed.
reviser_rechecks.locator: CSV Import parameter table, sample_size row; page lines 612-614 in the web access record.
reviser_rechecks.observed_operation: Opened the DuckDB primary documentation page and searched for sample_size. The displayed parameter row says it is the number of sample lines for auto detection and gives default 20480.
reviser_rechecks.governing_condition_default_exception: sample_size measures sample lines, not logical CSV rows; default is 20480 for auto detection. Quoted records may span physical lines, so this is not a row ceiling or a directly comparable count.
reviser_rechecks.applicability: Corrects F1 and removes the unsupported comparison to the brief's 80,000-row file; retain full-file logical-record reconciliation and do not let sniffing authorize stock changes.
reviser_rechecks.evidence_limitations: Moving preview documentation, not a pinned release; no DuckDB code was run.

reviser_rechecks.title: DuckDB issue #25827 — dialect change can discard earlier rows
reviser_rechecks.release_or_commit: Issue opened 2026-09-17; Open / needs-triage at recheck. The reporter's tested-build list includes main @ 2bbfe6f236 / v2.1.0-dev84749, 1.6.0.dev214, 1.5.5, 1.4.2 and 1.1.3.
reviser_rechecks.locator: Issue body: sample_size=-1 and null_padding results; tested-version matrix; status/labels and development/relationships metadata.
reviser_rechecks.observed_operation: Opened the upstream GitHub issue and directly checked its status, labels, reported options/results and build matrix. Did not run submitted code or reproduce the issue. The page showed no branches or pull requests linked at access.
reviser_rechecks.governing_condition_default_exception: Reporter claims the wide.csv case returns 29,000 rather than 30,000 rows by default; null_padding=true returns 30,000 with changed inferred columns; sample_size=-1 still returns 29,000. Reporter also claims a three-line example returns zero rows. These results are reported for the builds listed above.
reviser_rechecks.applicability: Consequential risk evidence for a DuckDB alternative: pin the contemplated release and regression-test full-file counts/schema if considered; do not rely on this report as a universal library guarantee.
reviser_rechecks.evidence_limitations: Open issue report, author-reported results only; this reviser did not execute or reproduce it. Issue page showed no linked fix, branch or pull request at access; absence on the page is not a complete release-history search.

critique_disposition.F1: Accepted and corrected: sample_size is sample lines, default 20480; removed row-equivalence inference.
critique_disposition.F2: Accepted with qualification: preserve the author's reported build/version matrix and option outcomes; do not present them as independently verified.
critique_disposition.F3: Retained as unresolved external input: no application repository/callers/tests were included in permitted inputs.
critique_disposition.F4: Accepted as wording ambiguity: guarantee a row-level local report; keep in-app report versus separate local file explicit for owner resolution.

performed: Read the assigned brief and all input-map predecessors/source index.
Opened and searched DuckDB preview documentation for sample_size.
Opened and checked DuckDB issue #25827 status, reported option results, and tested-build matrix.
not_performed: DuckDB executable run or reproduction of issue #25827.
Any implementation, tests, benchmark, supplier-file access/import, or production database operation.
